title: 水安全评分：独立评分与领导力封顶
summary: 水安全是独立评分；essential criteria 仅限领导力与 A 名单两层，并据此封顶最终等级。
sourceNote: 本页按 CDP 官方文件整理；悬浮「原文」可查看对应官方原文。正式填报请以 CDP 当期水安全评分方法为准。

blocks.content_cn: CDP 持续给出独立的气候变化、森林与水安全评分，每个议题有各自的方法学。

quote.text: CDP will continue to award separate Climate Change, Forests and Water Security scores in 2026. Each environmental issue area has its own separate methodology.

blocks.content_cn: 2026 年金融服务部门首次获得公开的水安全与森林评分（除非符合私评条件）。

quote.text: In 2026, organizations in the financial services sector will receive public Forests and Water Security scores for the first time, unless the organization is otherwise eligible to receive a private score in line with CDP’s scoring policies.

blocks.content_cn: 水安全 essential criteria 仅应用于领导力与 A 名单层；未满足则封顶。

quote.text: If a criterion is applied to Leadership level and the check is not met, this will limit an organization’s final score to a B. Similarly, if the A-list criteria are not met then the final score will be limited to an A-.

cards.content: 水安全 essential criteria 仅应用于领导力与 A 名单层，须全部满足才能进阶。

quote.text: Essential criteria for Water Security are applied across Leadership and A list levels.

cards.content: essential criteria 作用于整体评分，不会封顶或限制类别分数。

quote.text: Essential criteria are applied to the organization’s overall score in a particular environmental issue, and do not cap or limit category scores.

blocks.title: 水安全评分与气候同源的机制

cards.title: 四层阶梯
cards.content: 同样采用披露/认知/管理/领导力四级评分。

cards.title: 类别权重
cards.content: 类别权重仅用于管理与领导力层计算。

cards.title: essential criteria
cards.content: 仅作用于整体评分，不封顶类别分。

cards.title: 独立评分
cards.content: 水安全有独立方法学，与气候评分分开。
水安全同样以评分类别与权重组织，权重仅用于管理与领导力层，与气候方法同源。

quote.text: Weightings are applied to scoring categories at the Management and Leadership levels only.

cards.content: 除气候外，森林与水安全也按类别权重计算管理与领导力层分数。

quote.text: At the Management and Leadership levels, weightings are applied using category scores as they are for Climate Change and Water Security.

cards.title: GRI 303
cards.content: 与 GRI《水与污水：303》部分对齐。

cards.title: ISSB / IFRS S2
cards.content: 气候数据自 2024 年起与 IFRS S2 一致。

cards.title: ESRS E1
cards.content: 与 ESRS E1 具有高度互操作性。

cards.title: TNFD
cards.content: 2026 年扩大与 TNFD 自然相关披露的对齐。
CDP 整合企业问卷，与 ISSB 气候标准保持一致并扩大与 TNFD 的一致性。

quote.text: CDP 整合企业问卷，与 ISSB 气候标准保持一致，并扩大与 TNFD 的一致性。
